profile.headline: Results-Oriented Software Engineer | From Patrol Car to Agile Champion
profile.summary:
Ex-cop turned code warrior!  After nearly two decades keeping communities safe, I transitioned my passion for problem-solving and meticulous execution to the world of software engineering.  I bring a unique perspective, honed by years of strategic thinking and teamwork in high-pressure environments.

Now, as a highly proficient Software Engineer with a strong foundation in MERN Stack (React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB), I'm eager to leverage my skills to build secure, efficient, and user-friendly web applications.  I'm a fast learner with a knack for understanding complex systems and a proven ability to deliver results.

I'm a strong believer in collaboration and enjoy working within agile teams.  I'm always looking for opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute to a positive and impactful work environment.  I'm eager to hear about your projects and how my skills and experience can be an asset to your team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Greenwood Village, Colorado, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
● Consulted client for application development and analyzed the migration of an existing relational database to a document based database.

● Created wireframes with MockFlow of proposed application to bring the client’s proof of concept to life.

● Developed frontend application to move the client from a local hosted program to the cloud, using React, Redux, React Router Dom, custom CSS and forms.

● Identified new technologies and cloud based services and developed a cost reduction strategy that would reduce operational expenses up to 40%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Discovered and reconciled a critical bug within a time keeping component, generating a revenue gain between 10-15%.

● Debugged and resolved  connectivity issues with cellular medical devices between 3rd party and backend RESTful API services. 

● Managed feature development for custom healthcare app from inception to execution. Illustrated user interface wireframes. Advised application owner on user experience best practices.

● Delivered content within an agile environment. Participated in daily scrums, administered code demos and conducted code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · API Development · React · Agile Methodologies · Node.js · MongoDB · Express.js · HTML · Redux.js · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Amazon S3 · React.js · JavaScript · Javascript · Software Development · Microservices

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
● Developed responsive consumer facing UI components and customized administrator dashboard using React/Redux.

● Published and managed source code with Github and Git version control system.

● Optimized static content that increased load times by approximately 15%.

● Created custom forms that used Formik and material-ui to enhance user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React · HTML · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · React.js · Software Development

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
● Configured Stripe Connect and Connect Accounts API for secure and compliant payment processing.

● Established cross-device compatible payment processing UI and accompanying RESTful API services in .NET/C#.

● Ensured data stability with custom forms that used Yup client-side validation and error handling with matching server side validation.

● Collaborated within an agile/scrum environment. Presented ideas and demoed code.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · API Development · C# · React · Agile Methodologies · Visual Studio · Microsoft SQL Server · HTML · Stripe Connect · User Experience (UX) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · React.js · JavaScript · Javascript · Software Development · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · .NET Core

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
● Engineered responsive user dashboard and visualized data with ApexCharts.

● Created dynamically generated and responsive UI components with bootstrap styling.

● Designed SQL Server database tables and employed the use of stored procedures,
UDTs, FK constraints, and views.

● Used Amazon’s S3 SDKs to implement multi-file type upload functionality.

● Configured mobile friendly PDF generator with SendGrid for email automation.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · API Development · C# · React · Agile Methodologies · Microsoft SQL Server · HTML · Stripe Connect · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · React.js · Software Development · .NET Core

positions.title: Small Business Owner
positions.description:
● Maintained a 95% occupancy rate, with an average tenancy over two years.

● Developed annual operating budgets and forecasts with google docs.

● Responded to messages and inquiries from various parties and used well-developed active listening and open-ended questioning skills to promote quick resolution.

● Prepared projects, solicited bids, and approved contractors for building services.

● Monitored timely receipt and reconciliation of rent in accordance with policy.

● Conduct background checks and interview screening of applicants.

● Implemented third-party software, Zillow, to facilitate rental contract agreements.

positions.title: Law Enforcement Officer
positions.description:
● Colorado POST Certified Police Officer

● Trained citizens in the use of our crime reporting and tracking software.

● National Night Out Event Coordinator – management of 60 agency personnel, 40 event organizers (avg. attendance: 2,500) and a budget of $11,500.

● Crime Prevention/Education Outreach – conduct training for officers and citizen groups to reduce crime, increase quality of life and reduce demand on traditional police services.

● Team Lead for marijuana compliance of dispensaries – coordinated efforts with multiple governmental agencies and conducted on-site inspections.

positions.title: Insurance Agent
positions.description:
● Met sales goals for all products: Membership, Home, Renters, Condo, and
Automobile.

● Application of underwriting rules to ensure that only qualified applicants are
accepted.

● Perform in accordance with the company's Successful Sales Calls program.

● Communicate effectively between departments to ensure company and customer
needs are met.

● Deliver high level customer service to ensure loyalty and retention.

positions.title: Transportation Operations Manager
positions.description:
● Backhaul Coordinator – oversaw the movement of 150 vehicles and 300 personnel across the theater of operations.

● Transport Operator - Ensured safe movement of army and civilian personnel as well as equipment in theater with 40,000 plus miles of safe vehicle operation.

● Squad Leader - management of a 5 person team during combat operations.

● Combat Lifesaver – Critical trauma care and stabilization.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Cedar Rapids, Iowa, United States · On-site
positions.description:
● Project management for the intranet site for Commercial Aerospace Systems, a sub-division of Rockwell Collins, now a part of United Tech.

● Designed and implemented internal website using HTML and Javascript.

● Coordinated with multiple department heads to gather content, presented design concepts, wrote and managed code base.

● Process data entry requests for departmental changes.

● Analyze existing databases and ensure information is current across agencies.
